image_description: A vintage white and green minibus (resembling a UAZ-452 'Bukhanka') parked on an urban street. The vehicle features a rounded front end, split windshield, and boxy rear passenger compartment. Background includes a building facade, trees, and another blue vehicle partially visible on the left.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the characteristic high-roof, short-wheelbase proportions of a minibus/van. It is clearly distinct from a full-size bus.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large split windshield is prominent. Side windows are visible along the passenger cabin, though partially obscured by the angle and reflections.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle height is consistent with a minibus. A door handle and seam suggesting a sliding or hinged door are visible on the driver's side.
Door seams and handles are visible on the side, consistent with van/minibus entry mechanisms.
The short, rounded hood indicates a front-engine layout typical of this class of vehicle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is taken from a front-three-quarter angle; the rear of the vehicle is completely occluded.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle has a two-tone white and green paint scheme, fitting the description of company livery or custom paint.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Visible front wheel shows a standard steel rim with a hubcap, appropriate for a van/minibus.
The overall size and window configuration suggest a capacity within the 4-10 passenger range.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The brown mass above the windshield appears smudged and lacks distinct leaf structure, resembling AI-generated 'melting' or painterly blur rather than natural foliage.

The chrome bumper and grille details are indistinct and slightly warped. The emblem/logo area is nonsensical gibberish rather than a clear manufacturer badge, indicating structural confusion in fine details.
The blue car in the background has slightly warped geometry and unclear definition, blending into the background environment more than optically expected.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific model type and ensure it aligns with the 'minibus' class label despite the vintage styling.
To check for edge bleeding between the white/green paint and the background, and verify the continuity of the door seams.
To analyze the spatial relationship between the minibus and the background elements (building, other car) to detect any grounding errors.
To assess the severity of the texture anomalies in the foliage and the clarity of the mechanical parts (wheels, mirrors).

focus_areas: Wheel rim symmetry and tire contact patch
Edge sharpness between vehicle and background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the front grille and bumper area; AI often struggles with complex chrome reflections and symmetrical mechanical parts. Verify if the 'smudged' foliage is an artifact or just motion blur/low resolution. Check if the door handles are physically plausible.
